ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels covering approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and scattered in localized circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs are localized at the outer superior tips of both lobes. The left tip exhibits a high-intensity cluster extending along the trailing edge, while the right tip features a larger, more diffuse white region with irregular interior dark mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central depression is a shallow, obtuse V-shape with a calculated angle of approximately 125 degrees and a low-depth bounding box relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the majority of the boundary. A significant macro-indentation (missing tissue) is located on the right lobe's trailing edge, approximately 20% inward from the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The sweep follows a dual-convex trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips, with the right lobe displaying a sharper terminal angle compared to the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular rings (annular shapes) are visible. Significant concentrations are found in the lower mid-section of the left lobe and across the central-to-lower region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, thin, high-intensity linear marks are visible, primarily on the central-left region of the fluke, varying in length from approximately 20 to 100 pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, non-symmetrical indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe, likely representing a healed physical trauma. Extensive scarring from barnacle attachment points visible as white rings.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical high-intensity streak is visible at the very base of the fluke where it joins the peduncle, contrasting sharply against the dark surrounding tissue.
